session_1758719769093_3eb13732: To what extent do you support or oppose universal healthcare policies that provide government-funded healthcare coverage for all citizens? Please explain your reasoning.
column3: I strongly support universal healthcare. If everyone has access to care, it’s fairer and healthier for all. I believe government-funded coverage ensures no one is left behind because of cost. It connects to my belief that public medicine supports access to treatment. When people can get the care they need, it improves overall quality of healthcare. Plus, focusing on the patient and their care makes sense. Everyone deserves good medical attention, regardless of their income. That’s why I back universal insurance — it’s about fairness and quality.
